name: George Eid
title: Senior broadcast journalist and media trainer
bio_short: Senior broadcast journalist and media trainer with more than 20 years' experience. Head of News at Al Mashhad TV. Former Al Arabiya, Sky News Arabia and Voice of America. Fluent in Arabic, English, French, German and Greek.
bio: George is a senior broadcast journalist and media trainer with more than 20 years' experience across television, radio and digital media. He is currently Head of News at Al Mashhad TV in Dubai, where he leads a newsroom delivering major news programming and in-depth editorial coverage. His career spans senior roles at Al Arabiya, Sky News Arabia, Voice of America, MTV Lebanon and Cyprus Mail. His field reporting has included frontline coverage of the Syrian conflict in Aleppo with Sky News Arabia, and his work at MTV Lebanon as Deputy Editor-in-Chief earned multiple international awards.  George holds a Master's degree in Marketing Media and Management from Sorbonne University. He has lectured at Notre Dame University, Saint Joseph University and ALAC Leadership Academy, and served as Honorary Media Consultant to the Greek Embassy in Beirut from 2018 to 2020.  At ISOC, George delivers media training, public speaking and communication strategy programmes for executives and spokespeople. His five-language fluency in Arabic, English, French, German and Greek makes him particularly valuable for organisations that operate across linguistic and cultural boundaries. His current role as a working newsroom leader gives his training an authority and currency that is difficult to replicate. George is based in Dubai.
